name: OCR-Tibetan_line_to_text_benchmark
description:
Tibetan OCR-line-to-text Benchmark Dataset
	

This repository hosts a line-to-text benchmark dataset to evaluate and compare Tibetan OCR models. The dataset includes diverse scripts, writing styles, and print methods, enabling comprehensive testing across multiple domains.
💽 Datasets Overview

Features:
filename: Name of the file.
label: Ground truth text.
image_url: URL of the image.
BDRC_work_id: BDRC scan id for specific works.
char_len: Character count of the text.
script: Type of… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/openpecha/OCR-Tibetan_line_to_text_benchmark.
evaluation_method: character_error_rate (CER) and word_error_rate (WER), exact_match for shorter lines
reputation: A niche, specialist benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used by researchers and practitioners working on low-resource / historical-script OCR for Tibetan.
